purpose: adjudicate whether the newly launched Binance VIP Earn program creates a market-direction-independent incremental yield overlay on assets and VIP status that already exist for independent reasons

official_current_mechanism.headline_rate_relationship: up to 20 percent higher APR relative to retail Earn, not an additional 20 percentage points
official_current_mechanism.headline_quota_relationship: up to 10 times the retail subscription quota

current_evidence_boundary.reason: the durable official announcement and FAQs prove only headline relative maxima and eligibility mechanics; the current product-list SAPI endpoints are USER_DATA and the unauthenticated local VIP Earn page returned HTTP 202 with an empty body

VIP_1_public_qualification_context.holder_path: at least 100000 USDT equivalent average over the last 30 days or at least 100000 USDT equivalent during the previous day
VIP_1_public_qualification_context.trader_path: at least 1000000 USD equivalent Spot or 5000000 USD equivalent Futures or 200000 USD equivalent OTC over the last 30 days under the general table, with product-specific FAQ sections also publishing higher Trader VIP thresholds
VIP_1_public_qualification_context.borrower_path: at least 100000 USDT equivalent average net borrowing with the published BNB condition
VIP_1_public_qualification_context.qualification_rule: conflicting or path-specific published thresholds must be resolved against the exact account-facing VIP page; no path may be manufactured solely to obtain VIP Earn

economic_gate.accepted_scope_if_proved: incremental yield only on an independently already-held idle eligible asset when the account is already VIP for independent reasons and the exact VIP product dominates the exact available retail product after every cost and restriction
economic_gate.headline_upper_bound_identity: eligible_principal_times_0_20_times_exact_retail_APR_times_exact_holding_fraction, only when the exact offer is confirmed to receive the advertised maximum relative uplift
economic_gate.strict_positive_gate: every admitted product interval and the aggregate must remain strictly positive in the exact principal unit after all costs; missing exact rates quotas or eligibility reject
economic_gate.volatile_asset_rule: a volatile principal is not market-direction-independent unless it was independently already required or a separately proven hedge includes funding basis margin liquidation and execution costs
economic_gate.VIP_cost_rule: do not acquire hold trade borrow or generate volume to qualify; if VIP would not otherwise exist the incremental VIP Earn edge is zero under this candidate

distinctness.from_same_account_stable_value_yield_all: this is a newly launched account-tier-specific relative APR and quota overlay across VIP Earn products rather than one named public stablecoin campaign
distinctness.from_spot_fee_VIP: the benefit accrues on eligible Earn principal and does not require trading volume when VIP status already exists independently
distinctness.from_delta_hedged_BNB_reward_stack: this candidate credits no BNB reward or volatile asset value and prohibits obtaining VIP solely through BNB acquisition or manufactured activity

authenticated_read_only_retry_contract.trigger: both designated ephemeral Binance mainnet credentials are available to the process with explicit GET-only account-evidence authority, or Binance publishes a durable unauthenticated exact VIP product listing
permitted_endpoints_after_trigger: GET-only VIP account configuration endpoints needed to prove current level and eligibility
authenticated_read_only_retry_contract.required_join: exact VIP-tagged product APR quota duration redemption terms and availability joined to the exact retail comparator and independently existing idle owned eligible balance
authenticated_read_only_retry_contract.stop_condition: stop before every TRADE endpoint and before subscription redemption conversion transfer borrow order quote or account change

limitations: Up to 20 percent higher APR is a relative headline maximum, not a guarantee, not 20 percentage points, and not an exact product rate.
Up to 10 times quota is capacity, not yield or profit.
On-Chain Yield products can add protocol lock liquidity slashing smart-contract and redemption risks that are not represented by APR.
The local unauthenticated VIP Earn page returned HTTP 202 with zero bytes; that is not evidence that no products exist.
The official current flexible and locked product-list endpoints are USER_DATA, so no exact current product or account claim is made.
Published general and product-specific Trader VIP thresholds are not treated as interchangeable; exact account qualification remains unproved.
